text:
maria: Heads up — planning a quickpatch deploy during the 22:00 change window. Targets: api v3.2.0, runtime v2.14.1-quant, console v1.9.2, router v0.8. Need alignment on pin order and rollback plan.
kevin: On me for runtime. Need ~10m to stage kernels. Will pin runtime slot after you confirm canary.
anita: Console has a tiny schema tweak in v1.9.2 — could affect admin UI widgets. Can we A/B on one host first?
samir: Router ready. No header contract changes. I can hold traffic at 5% to the new runtime once canary is green.
maria: Plan: 1) pin runtime 2) deploy console canary 3) deploy API canary 4) shift router traffic 5) scale rollout. Rollback = pinback runtime + immediate route back.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy in 30m. Runbook: https://internal/release/6219
Commands:
``/deploy --component runtime --version v2.14.1-quant --pin``
``/deploy --component console --version v1.9.2 --canary 1``
kevin: Staging runtime kernels OK. Pin ready. I'll run pin at T-5.
anita: Putting console canary on host 1db-host-7. Watching UI errors, instrumentation toggled.
maria: @kevin please hold pin until I post the exact canary window (T-3).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runtime pin succeeded on pool 'dedicated-a' (slot:44).
samir: Router shifting 5% now — sending a small slice to canary runtime.
anita: Console canary shows intermittent 504s on admin/query when runtime cache header is present. Low volume but reproducible.
kevin: Saw the 504s in logs too. Looks like KV cache path mismatch with quant kernel. Recommend revert?
maria: Hold — don't roll back yet. Can we toggle cache bypass on the canary runtime to test? @kevin
kevin: Toggling prefix cache bypass on canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: cache-bypass toggled on runtime canary. Logs: https://internal/logs/runtime/621987/stream
``
INFO cache: bypass enabled
```
anita: UI errors dropped to 0 after bypass. Seems cache path triggers the issue.
maria: Decision: proceed with API canary but abort console full rollout. We will keep runtime pinned, block console v1.9.2 for now. Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx or latency >15s.
samir: Router will keep 5% for API/runtime canary. No console traffic to the new console version.
kevin: Confirm runtime pin stays. I'll open a quant-compat ticket and add logs.
maria: Thanks — I'll update release notes and notify release-bot. Anita, please file console revert PR.
release-bot: release-bot: updated release notes for deploy 6219876543: 'Runtime v2.14.1 pinned; API v3.2.0 canary; console v1.9.2 blocked due to cache incompatibility; router 5% traffic shift.'
anita: Filed PR #2421 to revert console bump and assigned infra for follow-up.
maria: :thumbsup: good call. We'll do a short postmortem if the fix requires runtime changes. Closing thread once deploy stabilizes.
